Mean, mode, geometric and harmonic mean parameterizations

Source: R/generators.R
summary_param.Rd

Replace a parameter of a continuous family by a summary of the law, so that the regression is on that summary: the mean, the mode, the geometric mean exp(E log Y) or the harmonic mean 1 / E(1 / Y). For given values of the other parameters the original parameter is found by root finding, as in quantile_param() (which covers the median and other quantiles). Expectations use 40 point Gauss-Hermite quadrature over Y = Q(Phi(z)), exact for log normal laws; the mode is the root of the derivative of the log density (or the lower end of the support).

Usage

summary_param(
  base,
  par = names(get_family(base)$pars)[1],
  type = c("mean", "mode", "geometric_mean", "harmonic_mean")
)

Arguments

base

Base family.

par

Parameter to replace (default: the first one).

type

"mean", "mode", "geometric_mean" or "harmonic_mean".

Value

A regcomp_family whose first parameter q is the summary.

Examples

gm <- summary_param("gamma", type = "mode")
# \donttest{
d <- data.frame(x = runif(200)); d$y <- rgamma(200, shape = 3, scale = exp(1 + d$x) / 2)
coef(regcomp(y ~ x, family = gm, data = d))
#>     q:(Intercept)               q:x sigma:(Intercept) 
#>         1.0546571         1.0990234        -0.6016625 
# }
